_doc: Single source of truth for narration + captions. *WORD* = red highlight word. Each seg is synthesized separately; 'after' is the silence (s) after it. 'gap' is silence after the line. 'card' lines render as a Scripture card instead of a caption page.

segs.t: Why doesn't God just appear in the *SKY* so everyone believes?
One sign, and every *DOUBT* would be gone…
right?
But He already did that once.
A whole nation saw *FIRE* on the mountain and heard His voice.
They didn't run to Him.
They ran *AWAY.*
Forty days later, they were dancing around a golden *CALF.*
Seeing God didn't change their *HEARTS.*
Now imagine He filled the sky tonight.
Everyone would *OBEY…*
…not out of love, but out of *FEAR.*
That isn't a family.
That's a *PRISON.*
God doesn't want to *OVERWHELM* you.
He wants to be *FOUND* by you.
And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
Even Thomas needed to see the scars.
Jesus showed him…
then said this:
Blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
He gives just enough *LIGHT* to follow…
and enough room to *CHOOSE.*
Would you rather have *PROOF…*
or *FAITH?*
Tell us why in the comments.
